items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: he had Vi Redd on alto saxophone

ctx.x: Yeah, 47th and Drexell. He came in with a band, and this was in the sixties, and he had an organ player, and he had Vi Redd on alto saxophone, a girl who plays very good alto. And a couple of singers. But it was just too much show business, not enough music. But I
guess that does stem from the early days at the Grand Terrace.
